## Page 3

KEY HIGHLIGHT FROM AGM 2025  (17 APRIL 2025)
Strategic Approval of RML548 Share Disposal – Unlocking Value and Future Growth
The disposal of RML’s stake (up to 60%) in RML548 Co., Ltd., the joint venture vehicle for the iconic One City 
Centre (OCC) project, was approved with strong support from shareholders.
Transaction Overview:
•RML548 is a 60:40 JV between RML and MEACH (Mitsubishi Estate Group) : "Build to Sell” strategy
•OCC has reached ~80% occupancy, reflecting strong demand and investor appeal
•Opening price 14,000 MB
•RML sells up to 60% shares 
•Within YR2025
Strategic Benefits:
•Turns loss to profit in 2025 via improved liquidity and stronger balance sheet
•Releases cash for:
➢Optimizing capital structure and reducing interest burden
➢Working capital for core & JV operations
➢Investment in high -growth real estate pipelines
•Unlocks asset value at a commercially optimal timing, while reducing project risk
“A value -driven milestone that enhances RML’s capital flexibility and positions it for 
sustained growth.”

## Page 15

Financial Efficiency Enhancement Plan
• OCC Value Unlock & Asset Sales: Currently in the process of selling the asset, with a target deal closure by Q4/2025. Non -core asset 
disposals will proceed in phases. Proceeds will be used to repay high -interest debt, strengthen liquidity, and set aside necessa ry 
reserves.
• Cost Rationalization & Capital Efficiency: Implement value engineering and re -bidding for procurement; tighten SG&A controls; 
revise incentive schemes to align with cash -based KPIs. Prioritize repayment of high -interest debt and evaluate repricing 
opportunities.
• Pipeline (Phuket, Pattaya): Pattaya – Asset -Lite : JV with the landowner to reduce up -front capex and accelerate time -to-market ; 
Phuket Mixed -use : Ongoing development with strong interest from HNWIs and foreign investors. Advancing partner discussions and 
progressing toward launch as scheduled.
• Governance & KPIs: Establish a Cost & Liquidity Council reporting to the CFO/CEO, with ongoing monitoring of cash runway, OCC 
occupancy/NOI, and cash proceeds from asset sales.

## Page 16

Financial Projections & Recover y Analysis
1) Cashflow Forecast
• Profit Turnaround: Targeting a return to profitability in 2026, 
led by OCC transfer; Kamala & Pattaya to support growth 
thereafter.
• Tourism Demand Upside: Strong foreign demand and 
inbound investment continue to drive sales momentum.
• Cashflow Inflection: Operating cashflow expected to turn 
positive from 1H/2026.
2) Sale of OCC by Q4/202 5
• Closing Timeline: Targeted completion by Q4/2025.
• Proceeds Deployment: Used to reduce debt, lower interest 
burden, and strengthen liquidity for transfers and construction.
• Stronger Balance Sheet: Post -transaction leverage decreases 
and debt -servicing capacity improves.3) Return to Financial Strength
• Rebuilding Momentum: Financial position supported by two 
key projects — Kamala and Pattaya.
• High -Margin Focus: Targeting foreign and tourism -led 
segments with strong margins and higher closing rates.
• Profitability & Liquidity: Net profit expected to turn positive in 
2026, with liquidity continuing to strengthen.
